subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What are 'los valores' in 'los valores tradicionales'?
questions.explain: 'Los valores' means 'values'; note 'valor' can also mean 'courage' or 'value/worth'.

questions.q: Translate 'el envejecimiento de la población'.
questions.explain: 'El envejecimiento' means 'ageing'; a key demographic social theme.

questions.q: What does 'imprescindible' mean, as in 'un cambio imprescindible'?
questions.explain: 'Imprescindible' means 'essential' or 'indispensable'.

questions.q: What does 'arraigado' mean in 'valores muy arraigados'?
questions.explain: 'Arraigado' means 'deeply rooted/entrenched'.

questions.q: In 'una persona sensible', what does 'sensible' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sensible' is a false friend meaning 'sensitive'; 'sensible' (reasonable) is 'sensato'.

questions.q: Translate 'el reparto de las tareas domésticas'.
questions.explain: 'El reparto' means 'sharing/distribution'; here, of household chores.

questions.q: What does 'la Iglesia' (capitalised) refer to here?
questions.explain: Capitalised 'la Iglesia' refers to the Church as an institution and its influence.

questions.q: What does 'el ciberacoso' mean?
questions.explain: 'El ciberacoso' means 'cyberbullying'; 'acoso' = harassment.

questions.q: What does 'el hogar' mean?
questions.explain: 'El hogar' means 'home' or 'household' (figuratively, the hearth).

questions.q: What does 'el matrimonio igualitario' mean?
questions.explain: 'El matrimonio igualitario' means 'same-sex / equal marriage'.

questions.q: Translate 'las redes sociales'.
questions.explain: 'Las redes sociales' means 'social networks/media'; 'red' literally means 'net'.

questions.q: What does 'actualmente' mean?
questions.explain: 'Actualmente' means 'currently/at present'; 'actually' is 'en realidad/de hecho'.

questions.q: What does the false friend 'embarazada' mean?
questions.explain: 'Embarazada' means 'pregnant'; 'embarrassed' is 'avergonzada'.

questions.q: What does 'el machismo' refer to?
questions.explain: 'El machismo' refers to male chauvinism or attitudes of male dominance.

questions.q: In discussing gender equality, what does 'la igualdad' mean?
questions.explain: 'La igualdad' translates as 'equality'.

questions.q: What does 'el bienestar' mean in a social context?
questions.explain: 'El bienestar' means 'wellbeing/welfare'.

questions.q: What does 'la igualdad de género' specifically address?
questions.explain: 'La igualdad de género' means 'gender equality'.

questions.q: Translate the idiom 'no tener pelos en la lengua'.
options: to be outspoken / not mince words
questions.explain: 'No tener pelos en la lengua' means to speak frankly / not mince words.

questions.q: In 'la brecha generacional', what does 'la brecha' mean?
questions.explain: 'La brecha' means 'gap' or 'divide'; here, the generational gap.

questions.q: What does 'la tasa de natalidad' refer to?
questions.explain: 'La tasa de natalidad' means 'the birth rate'; 'natalidad' relates to births.

questions.q: Translate 'la convivencia' in a social context.
questions.explain: 'La convivencia' means 'coexistence' or 'living together harmoniously'.

questions.q: Translate 'el éxito' into English.
questions.explain: 'Éxito' means 'success'; 'exit' is 'la salida'.

questions.q: Translate 'el ocio'.
questions.explain: 'El ocio' means 'leisure' or 'free time'.

questions.q: What does the idiom 'estar al día' mean?
questions.explain: 'Estar al día' is an idiom meaning 'to be up to date / current'.

questions.q: What is the false friend 'soportar' in 'no puedo soportarlo'?
questions.explain: 'Soportar' means 'to tolerate/put up with'; not 'to support'.

questions.q: What does 'apoyar' mean (e.g. 'apoyar a la familia')?
questions.explain: 'Apoyar' means 'to support'; note it differs from 'soportar' (to tolerate/bear).

questions.q: What does 'el divorcio' increasing reflect about 'la familia'?
questions.explain: Rising divorce reflects 'los cambios' — changing, more diverse family structures.

questions.q: What does the false friend 'asistir a' mean in 'asistir a una reunión'?
questions.explain: 'Asistir a' means 'to attend'; to assist is 'ayudar'.

questions.q: What does 'laico' mean, as in 'un Estado laico'?
questions.explain: 'Laico' means 'secular' or 'lay' (non-religious).

questions.q: What does 'la ropa' mean?
questions.explain: 'La ropa' means 'clothes/clothing'; 'rope' is 'la cuerda'.
